name: universal-browser-mcp
description: Private ChatGPT connection to the owner's Cloudflare Access-protected universal browser MCP for real website interaction, inspection and E2E testing.

interface.longDescription: Operate and test authorized public websites through owner-authenticated Cloudflare Browser Run, with isolated workspaces, actual UI actions, diagnostics and E2E. Administrative CRM service identity is not enabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open an authorized public site, keep the browser workspace ID returned by the current tool schema if present, inspect and test the real UI, and report verified results.
